export declare const CODING_CHANGESET_TYPE = "coding.changeset.v1";

export declare const CODING_FILE_CHANGED_EVENT = "io.molis.work.coding.file-changed";

export declare const CODING_PREFERENCE_EVENT = "io.molis.work.coding.preference";

export declare const CODING_RUN_UPDATED_EVENT = "io.molis.work.coding.run-updated";

export declare const CODING_WORKSPACE_INVALIDATED_EVENT = "io.molis.work.coding.workspace-invalidated";

export interface ChangeSet {
    workspace: FileSnapshotWorkspaceRef;
    path: readonly string[];
    before_exists: boolean;
    after_exists: boolean;
    before: string;
    after: string;
    source: ChangeSetSource;
    git?: {
        before_mode: GitFileMode | null;
        after_mode: GitFileMode | null;
        previous_path?: readonly string[];
    };
}

export type ChangeSetSource = {
    kind: "run";
    run_id: string;
} | {
    kind: "comparison";
    comparison_id: string;
} | {
    kind: "operation";
    operation_id: string;
};

export type CodingChangeScope = "run-frozen" | "workspace-current";

export interface CodingChangeSet {
    scope: CodingChangeScope;
    run_id: string;
    files: CodingFileChange[];
    applied: boolean;
    origin?: {
        session_id: string;
        runtime_session_id: string;
        workspace_id: string;
        workspace_name: string;
    };
    coverage?: "text-reviews";
}

export interface CodingFileChange {
    path: string;
    kind: CodingFileChangeKind;
    added_lines: number;
    removed_lines: number;
    diff: string;
    review?: {
        review_id: string;
        before_text: string | null;
        after_text: string;
        decision: "pending" | "approved" | "rejected" | "cancelled" | "expired";
        execution: "applied" | "failed" | "unknown" | "not-applied";
    };
}

export type CodingFileChangeKind = "added" | "modified" | "deleted";

export declare const DIFF_CHANGESET_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

export declare const DIFF_CHANGESET_TYPE = "diff.changeset.v1";

export declare const DIFF_STEP_BUDGET = 200000;

export interface DiffLine {
    readonly text: string;
    readonly ending: string;
}

export type DiffOp = {
    readonly kind: "equal";
    readonly line: DiffLine;
    readonly before: number;
    readonly after: number;
} | {
    readonly kind: "delete";
    readonly line: DiffLine;
    readonly before: number;
} | {
    readonly kind: "insert";
    readonly line: DiffLine;
    readonly after: number;
};

export declare const FILES_COLLECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

export declare const FILES_COLLECTION_TYPE = "files.collection.v1";

export declare const FILE_PATH_MAX_SEGMENTS = 64;

export declare const FILE_SEGMENT_MAX_LENGTH = 255;

export declare const FILE_SNAPSHOT_MAX_INLINE_BYTES = 1048576;

export declare const FILE_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

export declare const FILE_SNAPSHOT_TYPE = "files.snapshot.v1";

export declare const FILE_TEXT_SELECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

export declare const FILE_TEXT_SELECTION_TYPE = "files.text-selection.v1";

export interface FileSnapshot {
    workspace: FileSnapshotWorkspaceRef;
    path: readonly string[];
    text: string;
}

export interface FileSnapshotWorkspaceRef {
    workspace_id: string;
    name: string;
}

export interface FileTextSelection extends FileSnapshot {
    start: number;
    end: number;
}

export interface FilesCollection {
    workspace: FileSnapshotWorkspaceRef;
    collection: FilesCollectionAccess;
    selection: {
        path: readonly string[];
    } | null;
}

export interface FilesCollectionAccess {
    handle: string;
    display_name: string;
    entry_count: number;
    truncated: boolean;
}

export declare const GIT_FILE_CHANGED_EVENT = "io.molis.work.git.file-changed";

export declare const GIT_OPERATION_UPDATED_EVENT = "io.molis.work.git.operation-updated";

export declare const GIT_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

export declare const GIT_RESULT_TYPE = "git.result.v1";

export type GitFileMode = "100644" | "100755";

export type GitOperation = {
    action: "commit";
    message: string;
} | {
    action: "branch-create";
    name: string;
    checkout: boolean;
} | {
    action: "branch-switch";
    name: string;
} | {
    action: "push";
    remote: string;
    set_upstream: boolean;
} | {
    action: "pr-create";
    base: string;
    title: string;
    body: string;
    draft: boolean;
} | {
    action: "merge";
    branch: string;
} | {
    action: "pull";
} | {
    action: "resolve";
    path: string;
    content: string;
} | {
    action: "merge-abort";
};

export interface GitOperationRecord {
    operation_id: string;
    review_id: string;
    tool: string;
    summary: string;
    outcome: "pending" | "running" | "succeeded" | "failed" | "denied" | "cancelled" | "expired" | "unknown";
    detail?: string;
    failure_reason?: string;
    requested_at: string;
    decided_by: string | null;
    decided_at: string | null;
}

export interface GitOperationResult {
    workspace_id: string;
    operation_id: string;
    outcome: GitResultOutcome;
    summary: string;
}

export type GitResultOutcome = "succeeded" | "failed" | "denied" | "cancelled" | "expired" | "reconcile" | "conflict";

export interface GitReviewedResult extends GitOperationResult {
    review: {
        review_id: string;
        action: "stage" | "unstage";
        paths: readonly string[];
        requested_at: string;
        decided_by: string | null;
        decided_at: string | null;
        failure_reason?: string;
        reconciliation?: {
            actor_id: string;
            at: string;
            reason: string;
        };
        reconciliation_reason?: string;
    };
}

export interface PreparedWriterDirectory {
    worktree_id: string;
    branch: string;
    base_commit: string;
    canonical_path: string;
    workspace_id: string | null;
    problem?: string;
}

export interface SplitPair {
    readonly left: TextDiffRow | undefined;
    readonly right: TextDiffRow | undefined;
}

export interface TextDiff {
    readonly identical: boolean;
    readonly empty: boolean;
    readonly coarse: boolean;
    readonly ops: readonly DiffOp[];
}

export interface TextDiffRow {
    readonly kind: DiffOp["kind"];
    readonly before_number: number | undefined;
    readonly after_number: number | undefined;
    readonly text: string;
    readonly ending: string;
}

export declare const WORKSPACE_BYTES_LIMIT: number;

export declare const WORKSPACE_HANDLE_MAX_LENGTH = 128;

export declare const WORKSPACE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 256;

export declare const WORKSPACE_REF_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

export declare const WORKSPACE_REF_TYPE = "workspace.ref.v1";

export declare const WORKSPACE_SELECTED_EVENT = "io.molis.work.workspace.selected";

export declare class WorkspaceArtifactError extends Error {
    readonly code: "workspace.invalid_ref" | "workspace.handle_not_opaque" | "workspace.invalid_path" | "workspace.invalid_payload";
    constructor(code: "workspace.invalid_ref" | "workspace.handle_not_opaque" | "workspace.invalid_path" | "workspace.invalid_payload", message: string);
}

export interface WorkspaceFileQuery {
    workspace_id: string;
    path: readonly string[];
    kind: "directory" | "text" | "bytes";
}

export type WorkspaceFileResult = {
    outcome: "directory";
    entries: readonly {
        name: string;
        path: readonly string[];
        kind: "file" | "directory" | "other";
    }[];
    truncated: boolean;
} | {
    outcome: "text";
    text: string;
    fingerprint: string;
    mode?: GitFileMode;
} | {
    outcome: "bytes";
    data: string;
    bytes: number;
    fingerprint: string;
} | {
    outcome: "too-large";
    bytes: number;
    limit: number;
} | {
    outcome: "binary" | "unsupported" | "missing" | "denied" | "changed";
};

export type WorkspaceGitQuery = {
    workspace_id: string;
} & ({
    kind: "status";
} | {
    kind: "summary";
} | {
    kind: "pr-support";
} | {
    kind: "diff";
    path: readonly string[];
    side: "index" | "worktree";
} | {
    kind: "conflict";
    path: string;
});

export type WorkspaceGitResult = {
    outcome: "status";
    porcelain: string;
    head_commit: string | null;
} | WorkspaceGitSummary | {
    outcome: "pr-support";
    tool: "ready" | "missing" | "unauthenticated" | "unsupported";
    host: string | null;
    message: string;
} | {
    outcome: "conflict-file";
    path: string;
    text: string;
    conflicts: number;
    ours: string;
    theirs: string;
    revision: string;
} | {
    outcome: "diff";
    path: readonly string[];
    previous_path?: readonly string[];
    side: "index" | "worktree";
    before_exists: boolean;
    after_exists: boolean;
    before: string;
    after: string;
    before_mode: GitFileMode | null;
    after_mode: GitFileMode | null;
    revision: string;
} | {
    outcome: "denied" | "not-a-repository" | "unavailable" | "changed" | "unsupported" | "binary" | "too-large" | "conflict" | "missing" | "error";
    message: string;
};

export interface WorkspaceGitSummary {
    outcome: "summary";
    branch: string | null;
    head_commit: string | null;
    upstream: string | null;
    ahead: number;
    behind: number;
    branches: readonly string[];
    remotes: readonly {
        name: string;
        url: string;
    }[];
    staged: readonly {
        path: string;
        status: string;
    }[];
    unstaged: number;
    conflicted: readonly string[];
    merging: boolean;
    revision: string;
}

export interface WorkspaceRef {
    workspace_id: string;
    name: string;
    handle: string;
}

export interface WriterIntegrationFile {
    path: readonly string[];
    target: "added" | "modified" | "deleted";
    selectable: boolean;
    reason?: string;
    revision?: string;
    before_text?: string | null;
    after_text?: string | null;
    before_mode?: GitFileMode | null;
    after_mode?: GitFileMode | null;
    conflict?: {
        base_text: string | null;
        merged_text: string;
        clean: boolean;
        markers: number;
    };
}

export interface WriterIntegrationSource {
    session_id: string;
    run_id: string;
    subagent_id: string;
}

export interface WriterIntegrationView {
    workspace_id: string;
    writer_workspace_id: string;
    source_path: string;
    target_path: string;
    branch: string;
    base_commit: string;
    files: WriterIntegrationFile[];
}

export declare function fileSnapshotInlineBytes(content: FileSnapshot): number;

export declare function isOpaqueHandle(handle: string): boolean;

export declare function mayHaveChangedFiles(outcome: GitResultOutcome): boolean;

export declare function parseCodingChangeSet(value: unknown): CodingChangeSet;

export declare function parseFilePath(value: unknown, allowRoot?: boolean): string[];

export declare function parseFileSnapshot(content: unknown): FileSnapshot;

export declare function parseFileTextSelection(content: unknown): FileTextSelection;

export declare function parseFilesCollection(content: unknown): FilesCollection;

export declare function parseGitResult(content: unknown): GitOperationResult;

export declare function parseTextSelectionRange(start: unknown, end: unknown): {
    start: number;
    end: number;
};

};

        workspace_id: string;

        review_id: string;
